```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
# remotes::install_github("rundel/ghclass")
library(ghclass)
library(tidyverse)
library(glue)
```

```{r}
org_outside_collaborators <- function(org) {
  ghclass:::ghclass_api_v3_req(endpoint = "GET /orgs/:org/outside_collaborators", org = org) %>%
    purrr::map_chr("login")
}
```


```{r}
ghorg <- "Calvin-DS202-FA20"
(members <- org_members(ghorg))
students <- members %>% setdiff(org_admins(ghorg))
students <- union(students, org_outside_collaborators(ghorg))
paste(students, collapse = " ") %>% cat()
```

# Set up assignment templates

```{r}
org_sitrep(ghorg)
```

# Create Assignment

```{r eval=FALSE}
assignmentTemplatePath <- "lab/lab02-plastic-waste/"
assignmentName <- stringr::str_match(assignmentTemplatePath, r"{\w+/([a-z0-9]+)}")[,2]
assignmentName
```

```{r eval=FALSE}
repoName <- paste0(assignmentName, "-template")
repo_create(ghorg, repoName, gitignore_template = "")
repo_set_template(paste0(ghorg, "/", repoName))
system2("./make-repo.sh", c(repoName, assignmentTemplatePath))
```

```{r}
cat(glue("https://github.com/{ghorg}/{repoName}"))
```


# Harvest Student Work

```{r message=FALSE}
all_repos <- org_repos(ghorg)
assignmentName <- "hw01"
assignments_root <- "../fa20/"
assignment_path <- file.path(assignments_root, assignmentName)

# Clone or update repos for all students
repos_for_assignment <- students %>% purrr::map_chr(function(student) {
  student_repo_name <- paste0(assignmentName, "-", student)
  student_repo_fullname <- paste0(ghorg, "/", student_repo_name)
  repo_path <- file.path(assignment_path, student_repo_name)
  if (file.exists(repo_path)) {
    # Update (pull)
    local_repo_pull(repo_path)
  } else if (student_repo_fullname %in% all_repos) {
    # Clone
    local_repo_clone(
      repo = student_repo_fullname,
      local_path = assignment_path,
      verbose = TRUE
    )
  } else {
    message(paste0("Missing ", assignmentName, " for ", student))
    return(NA)
  }
  return(student_repo_fullname)
})
```

```{r}
all_repos <- org_repos(ghorg)
```

```{r}
repo_unwatch(all_repos)
```


```{r}
repo_unwatch(repos_for_assignment)
```

```{r}
repo_watching()
```
